title: Turning off services using sc exe
description: This query checks for attempts to turn off at least 10 existing services using sc.exe.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Command Line' like '*sc*' and 'Command Line' like '*config*' and 'Command Line' like '*disabled*') | timestats span = 5minute distinctcount('Command Line') as ScDisableCount, unique('Command Line') as ScDisableList by Entity | where ScDisableCount > 10
